description: Provider of commercial products, digital software applications, and customer support services.

departments.name: Billing & Financial Operations
departments.scope: Invoices, payment gateway errors, chargebacks, double-charges, subscription renewals, credit card failures, and refund requests.

departments.name: Information Security & Compliance
departments.scope: Suspected account takeover, compromised API keys, unauthorized access logs, vulnerability disclosures, and data privacy requests.

departments.name: Technical & Operational Support
departments.scope: System disruptions, 5xx server errors, application integration errors, webhook delivery timeouts, software bugs, and performance degradation.

departments.name: Account & Access Management
departments.scope: Password reset lockouts, TOTP MFA token desynchronization, role-based access delegation, team invitations, and profile configuration.

departments.name: Commercial Sales & Partnerships
departments.scope: Volume tier discounts, enterprise contract upgrades, bespoke SLA negotiation, procurement reviews, and commercial demo scheduling.

departments.name: General Inquiries
departments.scope: Public company information, headquarters location, partnership solicitations, feedback surveys, and unclassifiable communications.

precedence_rules: Financial disputes (double-billing, disputed charges, refund demands) MUST route to BILLING even if caused by technical glitches.
Compromised credentials, unauthorized logins, or leaked secrets MUST route to SECURITY even if involving account lockout.
System disruptions impacting software applications, service availability, or core platforms route to TECH_SUPPORT.
Authentication failures and TOTP MFA device resets route to ACCOUNTS.
Pricing inquiries and subscription tier upgrades route to SALES.
Vague, unclassifiable, or non-actionable inquiries route to GENERAL with the CLARIFICATION_REQUEST strategy.

P1.name: CRITICAL
P1.criteria: High Impact (3) AND High Urgency (4 or 5). Total system outage or ongoing financial/security loss.

P2.name: HIGH
P2.criteria: Medium/High Impact (2 or 3) AND Medium/High Urgency (3 or 4). Core capability degraded without workaround.

P3.name: MEDIUM
P3.criteria: Low/Medium Impact (1 or 2) AND Low/Medium Urgency (2 or 3). Non-critical feature failure with available workaround.

P4.name: LOW
P4.criteria: Low Impact (1) AND Low Urgency (1). General questions, documentation requests, minor UI glitches.

automatic_refund_eligibility: Duplicate charge on same billing cycle
Unused prepaid subscription canceled within 14 days of renewal
Service outage exceeding 99.9% uptime SLA documented by incident report
disallowed_refunds: Custom enterprise professional services and architectural onboarding fees
Charges incurred beyond 60 calendar days without prior notification

churn_escalation_triggers: Explicit threats to switch to competing platforms
Repeated unresolved P1/P2 tickets within a 7-day window
Public social review or negative ratings on Trustpilot or Google Reviews
